create_datasets_toy_clustering: create toy clustering datasets using make_circles, make_moons, and make_blobs from sklearn.datasets
compare_clustering_algorithms: compare eleven clustering algorithms including DBSCAN, HDBSCAN, OPTICS, MeanShift, and KMeans on toy datasets
run_clustering_pipeline: run a clustering pipeline that fits multiple algorithms and extracts labels from each
visualize_clustering_results: visualize clustering results as scatter plots with timing annotations for each algorithm-dataset pair
test_clustering_sensitivity: test clustering algorithm sensitivity by tuning parameters per dataset for noisy circles, moons, and varied blobs
